text:
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
Description
An
iRule event
triggered when an
HTTP::collect
command has collected the
specified amount of request data. Also triggered if the client closes
the connection before the
HTTP::collect
command finishes processing.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
HTTP
::
collect
20
}
when
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
{
set
rpc_id
[
findstr
[
HTTP
::
payload
]
"Authorization:"
14
20
]
persist
uie
$rpc_id
log
local0.
"WE RECORDED $rpc_id AS THE PERSIST VARIABLE"
HTTP
::
release
}
